meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 当用户发出 /learn 指令时，Claude 会把指定的目录、网址、粘贴的笔记或刚刚完成的工作流程，整理成一份可复用的技能说明书（SKILL.md），存入 .claude/skills/ 文件夹；如果已有同名技能，则原地更新、合并新内容，不删除旧内容。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」并指定目录、网址或粘贴笔记，或说“把这个流程做成技能”“改进某个技能”等要求时触发。

say.text: /learn 这个项目文件夹，建一个“项目指南”技能
say.note: Claude 会读取文件夹并生成技能文件。

say.text: 把我们刚完成部署的流程整理成技能
say.note: Claude 会回顾对话并提炼可复用步骤。

howto.what_en: On /learn, Claude turns a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the recent conversation workflow into a reusable SKILL.md saved in .claude/skills/. If the skill already exists, it updates it in place without overwriting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says '/learn' with a directory, URL, or pasted notes, or asks to turn a workflow into a skill, or to improve an existing skill.

say_en.text: /learn this project folder, make a 'project guide' skill.
say_en.note: Claude reads the folder and generates the skill file.

say_en.text: /learn https://example.com/docs, create a skill for calling that API.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the page and extracts steps.

say_en.text: Turn the deployment workflow we just finished into a skill.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the conversation and distills reusable steps.
